messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate observed from control-plane -> gateway (region: us-west). Threshold breached: 5xx > 5% for 10m. Paging on-call: @jordan_oncall.

jordan_oncall: Acked. I'm pulling logs + tracing now. Any customer-facing pages yet?

lee-sre: I'm seeing spikes in gateway 502/504s with origin set to "control-plane". Traces show increased latencies to auth and org-lookup backend. Samples: `auth_lookup: p50=120ms p95=1.8s errors=7%`, `org-lookup: p50=90ms p95=2.4s errors=5.5%`.

maria-platform: Confirmed. Dashboard: request success rate dropped to 89% for 12:03-12:12 UTC. Affected routes: /v1/models/* and /v1/generate (hosted). Potential cascade from a recent config rollout at ~11:55.

devops-bot: Deployment event detected: service=config-svc build:sha@a1b2c3 deployed to prod at 11:54:32 UTC. Rollout tags: feature/ephemeral-cache.

jordan_oncall: @lee-sre @maria-platform good catch re: config-svc. Can someone check if config-svc started fanout calls to billing/org at that time? Also paste any recent errors from the control-plane gateway.

lee-sre: Pasted sample gateway logs: ```
[12:05:14 UTC] gateway: upstream_retry failed: timeout to auth-service (10.0.12.7:443)
[12:05:14 UTC] gateway: 502 response to client, trace_id=trc-9fae
[12:06:33 UTC] gateway: org-lookup slow: 2.4s; downstream queueing observed
```

maria-platform: Running quick query across traces: majority of failing requests show `config-svc` as initiating a parallel fanout to `billing-svc` and `org-lookup` per request. Billing calls timing out (~1.5s) and causing connection saturation on control-plane connection pool.

sam-product: Any customers reporting errors? Support backlog shows a handful of 503s from high-traffic tenants on hosted endpoints. No major outage emails yet, but chat volume rising.

jordan_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Temporarily disable config-svc rollout OR revert to previous stable at `sha@9f8e7d`. 2) Throttle config-svc fanout concurrency (if possible) 3) Add an emergency 429 fallback in gateway for upstream timeouts to prevent queue storms. Who can rollback?

devops-bot: Rollback command available: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/config-svc config-svc=registry/config-svc:9f8e7d` — requires ops-lead or pipeline permission.

ops-lead: I'm available. Performing rollback now (triggering pipeline). Will post status. :construction_worker:

lee-sre: While rollback runs, add temporary rate-limit on config route at gateway: `limit_req zone=configburst burst=50` — should shed some pressure. Also open TCP pool diagnostics.

jordan_oncall: Applying rate-limit via runtime flag now. Patching gateway runtime config...

maria-platform: Traces show immediate improvement in connection queue depth after rate-limit and partial rollback started. 5xx dropped from 8.6% -> 3.2% over 90s.

ops-lead: Rollback complete. New pods at stable image healthy. Canary traffic shifted away from feature image.

sam-product: Support volume stabilized. Sent note to top 10 tenants we monitor. No escalations. :white_check_mark:

lee-sre: Post-mortem hypothesis: config-svc change introduced synchronous billing/org fanout per config fetch, increasing p95 and triggering upstream timeouts due to connection pool exhaustion. Failure mode: N+1 fanout -> partial cascading timeouts -> gateway 502/504.

jordan_oncall: Customer impact summary for pager: approx 6-10% of requests to /v1/generate returned 5xx between 12:03-12:10 UTC. No data exfiltration, no billing anomalies detected. Most affected were high-concurrency tenants.

maria-platform: Follow-ups: 1) Revert permanent until fanout is async/queued, 2) Add circuit-breaker and backpressure on config-svc (per-route concurrency limit), 3) Increase connection pool capacity in gateway and add better timeout defaults, 4) Add synthetic tests for config endpoints with fanout patterns.

ops-lead: Filing incident ticket (INC-2026) with timeline + actions. I'll assign owners for each follow-up.

jordan_oncall: Closing paging rotation. Please keep thread for action items. Great quick response team. :bow:

devops-bot: Incident incident-created: INC-2026 by ops-lead — summary and timeline uploaded to the incident board: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026

lee-sre: Quick snippet to reproduce locally (useful for testing fix): ```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" "https://gateway.prod/v1/config?tenant=test" &
done```

maria-platform: Adding eval to run weekly that simulates parallel fanout to catch regressions.

jordan_oncall: Last update: system healthy, rollback confirmed, incident downgraded. Will schedule postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Thanks all. :tada:
